message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large red letters at the top. Below the title, the words "DAN PERLU" are printed in smaller red letters. The cover features a person from behind, wearing a green and black jacket with a "TELKOMSEL" logo on the back. The logo consists of a red hexagon shape surrounded by a white swoosh. The person also wears a matching green motorcycle helmet with the Gojek logo and a small Telkomsel logo on the side. The person's right hand, clad in a black glove, is raised towards the helmet's visor.

The main headline, "MIMPI TELKOM MASUK GOJEK," is in bold white capital letters across the lower half of the figure. Below it is a smaller paragraph in white text. Two smaller headlines appear at the top: "KONFLIK TANAH SIRKUIT MANDALIKA" and "GEJOLAK PAPUA MENOLAK OTONOMI KHUSUS." A date "4-11 OKTOBER 2020," a price, a website, and a barcode with a QR code are located in the bottom right corner. The background is plain white with a vertical red stripe on the left edge and a horizontal red stripe at the bottom.
